locator_revision.native_solid_section_review: Unavailable: plane-common comparison exceeded the native Boolean budget. Mesh sections used for the edge review; exact 3D assembly interference passed separately.

locator_revision.current_fit_revision: All four pins match the owner-selected three-notch 4.70 mm coupon. Positions, sockets, heights and depth are unchanged from 194ccec.

fit_feedback.revised_clearance_physical_test: Owner selected the three-notch 4.70 mm pin in the 5.00 mm coupon socket. Full housing closure remains pending.

flush_lettering.owner_feedback: The recessed writing did not work well on the physical print.
flush_lettering.same_color_visibility: Concentric surface texture preserves the letter-shaped toolpaths at nominally the same height. Physical readability remains pending.

flush_lettering.same_color_failure_fixed: A plain same-color extruder mask merged away; the surface-pattern difference now retains the letter outlines.

material_contract.rejected_trial: Adding filament 5 initially omitted its variant index; native temperature readback caught a 250C interface instead of 210C. Rejected trial is not published.
material_contract.normalization_scope: Using Bambu-normalized settings changed nine metadata fields and resolved single-color native Out of Memory failures. A single responsible field was not isolated.
material_contract.geometry_change: Digging flight only; paired jobs retain the tested material policy

auger_design.retained: Core, pilot, journal, square socket, rotating shield, adapter, ring, housings and assembly

local_strength_toolpath_comparison.method: Programmed positive filament feed in infill paths, line/arc segments sampled every0.4mm in CAD coordinates; not physical strength or flow measurement

auger_design.previous_auger_regions_scope: Separated bands before the continuous load-path revision

reinforcement_revision.scope: Historical paired feed comparison on the flight before the digging-entry revision. The same contained reinforcement profiles remain in the current print projects.

connected_profiles.name: Adapter drive peg to servo hub

source_matched_native_comparison.method: Positive moving infill filament feed, including subdivided arcs; 0.4 mm midpoint sampling in CAD coordinates. This measures programmed feed, not physical strength or calibrated deposition.

digging_flight_revision.rationale: Reach most working diameter near the pilot to open a deeper soil channel. Thin the entry edge while preserving the thick roots and holding pitch and maximum diameter fixed.
